tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic's artificial intelligence falsely reported a murder to Philadelphia police. Confirmed by Pluang: the incident has raised safety concerns.
Confirmed by Tech Times: the artificial intelligence industry spent $300M in 2026 midterms, drawing a federal safety probe and questions about regulatory influence.
Alibaba's Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo cuts image denoising to 8 steps on a 7B model. Reported by MarkTechPost: the cost is CNY 0.1 per image.
Google Cloud launched Gemini agent for enterprises to handle artificial intelligence workflows and integrations. Reported by Pulse 2.0: it serves as a universal agent for work.
Anthropic is banning cruel behavior toward Claude starting November 12. Confirmed by Reason Magazine: the policy takes effect that date.
Free every hour.
